Style 1 JUDGMENT CALL (see report): page states year = '2nd-4th numerical digits combined' with the structure enumerated as letter, numerical digit, letter, seven numerical digits. Tested readings against sample W0K5896070: digit-only range reading gives '589' (not a valid year); character-range reading gives '0K5' (not digits); only the split reading — characters 2 and 4 concatenated ('0'+'5'='05' -> 2005) — yields a valid year, and 'combined' states concatenation. Shipped YEAR-ONLY on that reading with month (3rd character letter) held as chart-only; no era bound is stated on this page, so no yearFloor other than the 1960 default is claimed. Style 3 list/detail DUAL FORM: list shows 018812345 (9 digits), detail shows 0188123456 (10 digits, 'Used prior to 1992'); both decode month [0,2] and year [2,4] identically, and the combined pattern is disjoint from every other style in this file, so both forms are encoded.
